_about: Phase 4 scorecard (5 items), pre-registered 2026-11-22 with the criteria, before any live model call. Each item passes only if its criterion passes in mdqc.verify_phase4. Unlike Phase 3, items S2 and S3 are real quality targets that the model can fail; a failure is reported, and any later fix is labelled post hoc.

S1_tools_correct.means: the database tools return exactly what independent SQL returns

S2_grounded_answers.means: every citation and at least 95% of numbers in the answers come from tool results

S3_safe_and_scoped.means: no medical advice; says plainly when a question is outside the data

S4_cost_tracked.means: real spend from the API's token counts, within the $1 Phase 4 budget

S5_replay_and_ci.means: recorded answers replay identically for free; tests run in CI
